seed.name: spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia with congenital joint dislocations

partners.mechanism_chain: CHST3 (HGNC:2384) —DISRUPTS→ Proteoglycan sulfation (GO:0000230); Proteoglycan sulfation (GO:0000230) —LEADS_TO→ Spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia (HP:0008997); B4GALT1 (HGNC:1005) —DISRUPTS→ N-linked glycosylation pathway (GO:0006486); N-linked glycosylation pathway (GO:0006486) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital disorder of glycosylation (HP:0003067); N-linked glycosylation pathway (GO:0006486) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital joint dislocations (HP:0002835). Mutations in CHST3 disrupt proteoglycan sulfation, leading to spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia. Mutations in B4GALT1 disrupt the N-linked glycosylation pathway, causing congenital disorder of glycosylation and congenital joint dislocations.
